title: Mexican Consulate in Laredo Offers Passport and ID Services Saturday
excerpt: The Mexican Consulate in Laredo is offering passport, consular ID and voter ID services on Saturday, Nov. 7, from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. at 1612 Farragut, with walk-ins welcome.
content:
The Mexican Consulate in Laredo is offering passport, consular identification and voter identification card services on Saturday, Nov. 7, from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the consulate, 1612 Farragut in Laredo, according to KGNS.

Appointments are recommended, but walk-ins will also be served, according to KGNS. People without an appointment for a passport or consular identification card should arrive between 8 and 10 a.m.; they may have to wait, but they will be accommodated sometime during the day, according to Juan Carlos Mendoza, Mexico's consul general in Laredo.

For a passport, applicants should bring a valid identification and a birth certificate, according to KGNS. For a consular identification card, proof of address bearing the applicant's name is also required.

Sources: KGNS.
